purpose: Teach: マトリックス/パンダ/ウェールズ/マイホーム/ビーム/スピン/うなぎ/デイトレ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、マトリックスの映画見たろ?
lines.en: Hey, Riku — have you seen the Matrix movies?
lines.style: Casual, bright opening. Genuine curiosity without pressure. Lean-in energy. Testing whether he'll engage or deflect.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、動物園でパンダの前ではしゃいだろ?桜
lines.en: You're the one who got excited at the panda enclosure at the zoo, Sakura.
lines.style: Light, deflecting tease. Small smile in the voice. Not mean — turning the mirror back on her with the ease of someone who knows her well.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会科でウェールズの単元覚えてるか?
lines.en: Okay, but do you remember the Wales unit from social studies?
lines.style: Slight challenge underneath. Softer than the first question — actually wants to know. Leaning slightly forward in the conversation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお父さん、マイホーム建てたばかりだろ?桜
lines.en: Your dad just finished building your new house, didn't he?
lines.style: Observant, matter-of-fact. Not congratulatory — just noticing something she mentioned. Quiet certainty. Eyes staying level.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のレーザーポインターのビーム、強いな
lines.en: That laser pointer of yours — the beam's actually pretty strong.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation, understated. Not overdoing it. The kind of notice that lands because it's specific and real. Slight warmth.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、スピン技得意だろ?桜
lines.en: You're pretty good at spin tricks, aren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Soft acknowledgment. Not performing praise — just confirming something he's watched her do. Quiet confidence in the observation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、うなぎが嫌いなんだろ?
lines.en: Wait — you really don't like eel?
lines.style: Surprise registering genuinely. Quick, open. Not disbelieving — just discovering something new about him. Warm curiosity.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、デイトレって興味ある?桜
lines.en: Are you actually interested in day trading?
lines.style: Leaning in closer. Softer, more personal territory. Real question — not surface-level. Checking if he's serious or just thinking out loud.
